name: iso-27001-isms-implementation-suite
known_facts: ISO 27001:2022 has 93 Annex A controls across 4 themes
Statement of Applicability (SoA) must include ALL 93 controls with justification
Stage 1 audit is documentation review; Stage 2 is implementation verification
Surveillance audits occur annually; recertification every 3 years
Internal auditors must be independent of audited area
ISO 27001 follows the High-Level Structure (HLS) common to all ISO management standards

input.isms_scope: Entire organization including all SaaS products and corporate systems
